name: Beta / Early Access (SDLC Phase 10)
description: Managing beta program and early user feedback — aka Private Beta, Pilot, Dogfooding, Soft Launch.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Beta / Early Access Management
capabilities.description: Runs a controlled early-access program that captures real user feedback and validates readiness before general availability.

services.name: Beta Entry/Exit Criteria
services.contractDescription: Cohort selection rules, entry prerequisites, exit gate thresholds, and feature flag access limits.

services.name: Feedback Capture & Analysis Plan
services.contractDescription: In-app feedback widgets, structured survey Cadence, and customer interview triage workflow.

services.name: Beta Success Metrics
services.contractDescription: Daily Active Users (DAU), feature adoption rates, NPS / CSAT targets, and crash-free session metrics.

services.name: Support Playbook for Beta Users
services.contractDescription: Dedicated support slack channel protocol, response SLA matrix, and escalation path for beta participants.

services.name: Known Issues Log
services.contractDescription: Public/internal active bug log, workaround instructions, and scheduled fix milestones.

services.name: Risk Mitigation Plan
services.contractDescription: Data rollback plan, cohort de-escalation steps, and incident communication protocol for beta regressions.

policies.name: Beta Exit Criteria Fulfillment Standard Policy

checklists.name: Beta / Early Access (SDLC Phase 10) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for beta program execution, feedback triage, and general availability readiness.

items.statement: Feedback from beta users is being captured, triaged, and reflected in the known issues log on an ongoing basis.
Beta entry and exit criteria are explicitly approved by product management and engineering leads.
Beta user crash-free session rate meets or exceeds the 99.5% target.
Dedicated support channel and escalation playbook are operational with defined response SLAs.
Customer feedback analysis demonstrates positive CSAT trend and validates key value assumptions.

reviewGates.name: Beta Program Review
reviewGates.statement: The Beta Entry/Exit Criteria and feedback analysis have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to General Launch.
reviewGates.prompt: Has the Beta program successfully met its exit criteria, user feedback targets, and stability metrics?
